# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX confirmation filter (VIX >= 20 and rising) to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will avoid loser days (5/05,5/06,5/07) while preserving winner days (4/29,5/01,5/04) because those winner days exhibited elevated and rising VIX, whereas loser days had low or falling VIX. This filter targets the volatility regime edge observed in J's bearish trades.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger remains unchanged: require level rejection + EMA ribbon flip (fast < pivot < slow) + confluence with multi-day or premarket structure. Add a pre-entry filter: VIX >= 20.0 AND VIX 5-bar slope >= 0 (rising or flat). Exit logic unchanged: chart-stop primary (SPY closes 3-min candle above rejected level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock arms at +5% favor trails 0.15 off HWM, premium stop catastrophe cap at −50% (Safe), time stop 15:50 ET. Position sizing per risk-rules.md (ITM-2/ATM per account tier).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure 1).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample would be J's 6 anchor days only if we had backtest; otherwise Stage-1 backtest would use 16-month SPY 5m bars (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) with potential overfit risk from optimizing VIX threshold on small anchor set.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill validation on top 3 J days not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: filter may reject all entries on a low-VIX winner day (if any), turning winners to zero; max drawdown scenario: filter fails to avoid losers during volatility spikes; blow-up scenario: persistent low-VIX regime causes strategy to sit out, missing recovery edges.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute concentration.
